It is said that the dragons of the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs guard a lot of treasure. Kill 50 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and/or {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and then look for a {item:Hoard of Dragon Gold} to get a random reward. The task can be repeated right away and, after 10 times, you get the achievement **Hoard of the Dragon**.
Rumour has it that the dragons of the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs have piled up a lot of treasure...
only once, from the Dead Explorer
Each time you complete it: a random reward (see table)
Achievement **Hoard of the Dragon** when you complete it 10 times
Dragons killed in **any** of the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs count towards the 50, but only the new lairs (Tiquanda) have Hoards of Dragon Gold.
The southern lairs have several Hoards of Dragon Gold; the northern ones have only one.
The {wiki:Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs/Tiquanda|Tiquanda lairs} are on the **Tiquanda** side (the Port Hope jungle) of the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains, north of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}. There are two ways:

Take the boat to Port Hope (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the captain). Cross the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle to the **east** to the Kha'zeel mountains and look for the entrances at the coordinates below.

Take the boat to Ankrahmun ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}). Leave the city to the **west**, climb the mountains (with {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge at the top (with a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down to the stairs: you are on the Tiquanda side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}. From there head **north** to the entrances.

In the jungle there are {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Elephant|Elephants}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles} and, sometimes, {creature:Hydra|Hydras} drawn in by other players.

The quest starts automatically when you take a few steps in the underground passage that leads to one of the two sets of {wiki:Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs/Tiquanda|Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs (Tiquanda)}. Go down through one of these entrances.
In the passage, open the skeleton of the {item:Dead Explorer} to receive a {item:Red Dragon Scale}.
You can only open one of these skeletons: once you open the one in a passage, the one in the other passage no longer opens.
Kill a total of **50** {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} in the {wiki:Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs}. Those from any Kha'zeel lair count.
There are also {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings} and {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings}. Dragon Lords hit hard with fire: be careful if you are low level.

If you use a Hoard of Dragon Gold before you have the 50 kills, the message *"You try to pick a treasure, but you hear further dragons approaching. You should kill some more before picking out something."* appears. Keep hunting.

With the 50 kills done, look for a {item:Hoard of Dragon Gold} (several in the southern lairs, only one in the northern ones) and **use it**. You receive a random reward and the message *"It is impossible to take along all of the treasures here. But you pick out [...]"*.
The counter goes back to **0 kills** and you can repeat the task right away. On the 10th time you earn the achievement **Hoard of the Dragon**.
Achievement Hoard of the Dragon (10 times)

To leave, go back through the same underground passage to the entrance you came down by and go up to the surface. Then return to **Port Hope** through the jungle (to the **west**) or to **Ankrahmun** through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} (**south** and then **east**, the same way you came) and take the boat.
This quest is part of the {wiki:Adventurers Guild (Quest)|Adventurers Guild Quest}.
